about_company.about_short: Lead recycler (76% of FY26 revenue) scaling copper recycling; plastics and aluminium are small verticals.
about_company.about_long: Pondy Oxides and Chemicals Limited (POCL) recycles scrap into non-ferrous metals and granules across four verticals: lead (204,000 MTPA), copper (12,000 MTPA), plastics (9,000 MTPA) and aluminium (12,000 MTPA). Lead - pure lead and 100+ alloys sold mainly to lead-acid battery OEMs - was 76.2% of FY26 consolidated revenue of Rs 2,958.4 Cr; copper, sold as recycled copper grades (Clove, Cobra, Mill Berry) to copper wire and other copper users, was 22.7%; plastics and aluminium together were 1.1% (shares derived from the FY26 annual report's segment table). Scrap comes from 300+ overseas suppliers in 90+ countries: imports were about 73% of lead and 98% of copper procurement in FY26. Exports were 66% of FY26 revenue (issuer-stated; the consolidated geography note gives 63.8%), across 20+ destinations led by Southeast Asia; in Q1 FY27 exports fell to 45% of sales as copper, which sells 75% domestically, scaled. A Rs 200 Cr, 36,000 MTPA LME Grade A copper cathode plant is planned, with Phase I (18,000 MTPA) expected to be commissioned by December 2026 - today's copper output is recycled copper, not cathodes. Figures in the issuer's decks are standalone; the gap to consolidated is the plastics subsidiary POCL Future Tech (Rs 23.6 Cr turnover in FY26), whose amalgamation into the parent is pending before the NCLT.
about_company.business_intro: POCL buys lead, copper, plastic and aluminium scrap - mostly imported - and smelts, refines or extrudes it into pure lead, 100+ lead alloys, recycled copper and plastic granules. Lead-acid battery manufacturers in India and overseas are the core buyers of its lead products; copper goes to wire and other copper users. Revenue is the sale of these recycled products, 66% of it exported in FY26, and management runs each metal on EBITDA per tonne sold.

Lead-acid battery manufacturers in India and overseas are the core customers for lead products; copper is sold to copper wire and other copper applications.

business_facts.text: Exports as a share of total turnover, the issuer's own series: 54% FY22, 57% FY23, 56% FY24, 66% FY25, 66% FY26 (the FY26 BRSR also says 66%). The consolidated geography note puts revenue from outside India at Rs 1,888.7 Cr of Rs 2,958.4 Cr, or 63.8%, in FY26 (64.5% in FY25). Sales go to 20+ export destinations, mainly Southeast Asia. In FY26 lead sold 74% to exports and copper 42%; in Q1 FY27 the overall export share fell to 45% as copper, 25% exported, scaled.

business_facts.text: A 36,000 MTPA LME Grade A copper cathode facility at Thervoykandigai, about Rs 200 Cr funded from internal accruals, in two phases: Phase I of 18,000 MTPA expected to be commissioned by December 2026 (trial runs in Q4 FY27), Phase 2 targeted for Q3 FY28. About Rs 25 Cr had been spent by Q1 FY27; of the Rs 175 Cr FY27 capex plan, Rs 140 to 150 Cr is for this plant. Not yet operating - current copper output is recycled copper, not cathodes.

what_changed.text: Copper segment revenue rose from Rs 55.5 Cr in FY25 to Rs 672.6 Cr in FY26 after recycling capacity doubled to 12,000 MTPA and copper sales volumes rose from 700 MT to 6,543 MT; lead grew 14.8% to Rs 2,253.7 Cr but its share fell from 95.4% to 76.2%. Lead still earned most of the profit: segment result Rs 190.0 Cr against copper's Rs 25.0 Cr. Separately, the board approved on 28 January 2026 the amalgamation of the plastics subsidiary POCL Future Tech into the parent; the NCLT application is pending, and as a 100% subsidiary it does not change consolidated figures.
